name: Innyuu Sousakan Aria
source: Ogawa Aria is a special investigator. She gets a case to investigate a company. As part of her investigation she infiltrates a strip club. Slowly, she collected information. But, her secret was exposed and she was kidnapped. In a basement under the club, she was injected with aphrodisiacs, and her indulgence of pleasure began.
